rules: one canonical identity per semantic object
assurance records bind object_ref lifecycle:<logical_id> and object_hash sha256:<version_id>
version_id is SHA-256 of jai.lifecycle.version.v2 followed by a NUL byte and the canonical jai.lifecycle.manifest/2 JSON bytes produced by lifecycle.manifest and lifecycle.version_id
canonical manifests recursively NFC-normalize strings and keys, reject duplicate normalized keys and floats, sort keys, preserve array order and exclude locators
composite members are sorted by role and logical_id and bind exact member version_id values
content blobs use exact bytes with the jai.lifecycle.blob.v2 NUL-terminated SHA-256 domain
contract_ref and context_digest belong to the immutable semantic manifest; display labels and file locators do not define identity
profile-local identifiers must declare canonical_ref when representing an existing semantic object
